node.statement: Adjoint/product comparison. Instantiate lem-hcb2-product-defect with its corner indices (R,P,R), first factor Z^dagger in M_n tensor S_{R,P}, and second factor Z in M_n tensor S_{P,R}. Using dagger isometry gives ||D_n(Z^dagger dot Z)-(Ha^Q_{R,P})_n(Z^dagger)T_n(Z)||<=C_prod*e*||Z||^2. By lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness, (Ha^Q_{R,P})_n(Z^dagger)=T_n(Z)^dagger. The C*-identity for bounded operators between the amplified Hilbert column spaces gives ||T_n(Z)^dagger T_n(Z)||=||T_n(Z)||^2; hence reverse triangle inequality yields ||T_n(Z)||^2>=||D_n(Z^dagger dot Z)||-C_prod*e*||Z||^2.
